name: price_alert
description: View and change price-alert thresholds (the conditions that fire later), not the alerts that already triggered. Use for 'change my BTC alert to 110k', 'list my price alert thresholds', 'raise the Tesla price alert', or 'add a SOL price alert'. Actions: list, update, add, remove. add can save a new symbol, but that alert will not fire until the price-monitor workflow has a fetch path for the asset. For 'what triggered alerts do I have?', use list_alerts.

action.description: Action to perform: list (show all alerts), add (create new), remove (delete), update (change value)

symbol.description: Asset symbol or name: BTC, bitcoin, TSLA, tesla, gold, silver, etc. Automatically mapped to correct ticker.

condition.description: Alert condition: 'above' (price >= value, default), 'below' (price <= value), 'percent_change_24h' (daily move >= value%)

value.description: Target price or percentage. For add/update: the threshold value. For percent_change: the percentage (e.g., 5 for 5%).

old_value.description: Optional for 'update': specific value to change. If omitted, updates first matching condition.

severity.description: Alert severity level. Default: high (required for TTS to speak alerts)

message.description: Optional custom message for the alert. Auto-generated if not provided.
